svg.title: b3-human-corrects-agent-holds-old-id
svg.desc: b3-human-corrects-agent-holds-old-id: 10 steps over 2 days from 2026-04-01. Actors: a1 (agent, claude-code), h (human). a CLI supersession of a curated fact, then an agent supersedes the stale id. 1. [0d] a1 ingest # API rate limiter → $doc. 2. a1 remember The rate limiter allows 100 requests per minute per key. → $f1; expects 1 thing. 3. h promote $f1; expects 1 thing. 4. [1d] h remember The rate limiter allows 500 requests per minute per key. → $f2; expects 2 things. 5. h history $f1; expects 4 things. 6. [2d] a1 remember The rate limiter allows 200 requests per minute per key.; expects 2 things. 7. a1 remember The rate limiter allows 200 requests per minute per key. → $f3; expects 3 things. 8. h compact platform → $item; expects 5 things. 9. h facts platform; expects 2 things. 10. a1 search rate limiter requests per minute; expects 2 things.
